description: Source code for a web scraper class 'DagelijkseKost' that extends 'AbstractScraper'. It includes functions for calculating Levenshtein distance, extracting JSON data from script blocks, and parsing instructions from JSON data. The class provides methods for retrieving the host, canonical URL, and instructions for recipes from the 'dagelijksekost.vrt.be' website.

classes.name: DagelijkseKost
classes.description: A scraper class for 'dagelijksekost.vrt.be' extending 'AbstractScraper'. Implements methods to get host, canonical URL, and recipe instructions.

methods.name: canonical_url
methods.description: Returns the canonical URL if available, otherwise the original URL.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and returns recipe instructions by parsing embedded JSON data and comparing instructions with a fuzzy matching approach.
